properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28, closing the reflow workflow review. Accepted and not dropped, and better evidenced than most parked items: the risk was identified analytically the same day (report.rs:566 rolls delivery up a decomposition without ever asking whether the children cover the parent) and then observed in the field (reflow's own 01 monolith split into 01a-01f, losing context_management and self_improvement from every child, unnoticed for months). Deferred because the honest form is a QUESTION AT DECOMPOSITION TIME with the answer recorded, not a computed refusal — nothing can mechanically decide whether two children amount to a parent, and a detector that guessed would either block correct narrowing or bless real loss. That makes it a handshake to design (which question, asked when, recorded where) rather than a check to write. Must apply to decomposition alone: req:requirement-lineage distinguishes decomposed from derived, and a derived requirement adds new technical necessity nobody asked for, so it is not expected to cover anything.
